title: Auteur
description: Create cinematic shots, tell stories and capture your world.
body:
# Auteur

Auteur is a replay and recording tool for Minecraft focused on cinematic content creation.

The goal of Auteur is to provide creators, filmmakers and storytellers with powerful tools for capturing gameplay, creating replays and producing cinematic videos directly from Minecraft.

## Current Features

### Replay Recording

Record gameplay sessions and save them as ".auteur" replay files.

### Simple Recording Controls

Start and stop recordings using a dedicated keybind.

### Custom Replay Format

Auteur stores recordings using its own replay format, designed specifically for future replay and cinematic tools.

## Planned Features

The following features are planned for future releases:

- Replay playback
- Replay browser
- Timeline editing
- Camera paths
- Keyframes
- Cinematic camera tools
- Advanced creator workflow

## Alpha Notice

Auteur is currently in early alpha development.

This release is primarily intended for testing the recording pipeline and replay format. Many planned features are not yet available.

## Requirements

- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
